((count, sheets = 1) => {
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.className = 'budget-target';
  document.body.append(target);
  for (const sheetIndex of Array.from({length:sheets}, (_, index) => index)) {
    const selectors = Array.from({length:count}, (_, index) => '.budget-' + sheetIndex + '-' + index);
    selectors[selectors.length - 1] = '.budget-target';
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = selectors.join(',') + '{width:73px}';
    document.head.append(style);
  }
  return getComputedStyle(target).width;
})
